subject: Helix pilot: service-space activation, API seeding & invite choreography
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom@helixtx.com>, Alyssa Green <alyssa@helixtx.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helix pilot: initial activation requirements (handoff)

Neha / Ben —

Quick handoff for the Helix pilot (starting next week). Summary and asks below so we can hit day-1 generation and test traffic: 

Summary: Helix Therapeutics will pilot Redwood for API-driven summary and search embeddings on a scoped project. They need an isolated service-space, seeded API credentials for automation, and a small admin cohort invited into their workspace with RBAC mapped to their roles.

Action items for Redwood operations (please confirm ETA):
- Create a new service-space/project named "helix-pilot-prod" (ephemeral staging OK) and provide the project id.
- Seed two API keys scoped to: (a) ingestion pipeline (write-only, 30d TTL), (b) inference (read/generate). Mark keys as rotated-only by ops.
- Invite admin users: Tom Ellis (admin), Alyssa Green (developer) + one security reviewer (TBD).
- Apply RBAC: Admin = full workspace; Developer = generate/embeddings only; no billing visibility.
- KMS request: Helix prefers their AWS KMS CMK for secrets; ask Security if we can scope a tenant-specific envelope key.
- SSO/SAML: Helix will send SAML metadata (they plan to use Ping). If SAML not approved by pilot start, we'll proceed with invites and standard credentials.

Attached is an initial access matrix with the Helix proposed users + proposed timelines. Also include the SAML metadata if they send it.

Tom / Alyssa — Monica and I worked through the scope; Neha will be your onboarding owner from infra-onboard. Please confirm your preferred admin email and whether SSO must be live before we seed keys.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: helix_access_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom@helixtx.com>, Alyssa Green <alyssa@helixtx.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix pilot: initial activation requirements (handoff)

Thanks Monica — taking point on this. High-level plan below and a proposed timeline: 

Plan & next steps (Neha / Ben / Helix):
1) Quick sync: 30-min kickoff to validate admin list, SSO constraints, and KMS ask. Proposed: Fri 2026-09-03 10:00 AM PT. (I will send a calendar invite once Tom confirms.)
2) Provisioning: Ben will create the service-space and seed keys (Target: 1 business day after kickoff if no SSO blocker).
3) Invites & RBAC: I will invite the listed admins; we will keep the security reviewer as an observer until the CMK discussion completes.
4) KMS & compliance: I'll loop in Security if Helix requires customer-managed CMK — that usually adds ~3 business days for approvals.
5) Smoke tests: Once keys are seeded, we will provide a short cURL checklist and a smoke-test token for Helix to validate.

Questions for Helix (Tom / Alyssa):
- Please confirm the admin emails you want invited (exact spelling).
- Is SSO required before we seed any keys or is it acceptable to start with direct API keys and migrate to SSO later?
- Any IP allowlist requirements for the API keys?

I'll kick off the provisioning as soon as Tom confirms the 10 AM slot or proposes an alternate.

--
Neha Kapoor
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Ellis <tom@helixtx.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Green <alyssa@helixtx.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix pilot: initial activation requirements (handoff)

Thanks, Neha — 10 AM PT tomorrow works for us. Quick answers inline: 

- Admin emails for invites: 
  Tom Ellis <tom@helixtx.com> (primary admin)
  Alyssa Green <alyssa@helixtx.com> (developer)
  Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@helixtx.com> (security reviewer, read-only observer)

- SSO: We prefer SSO for production, but for the pilot it's acceptable to use seeded API keys first and swap to SSO once SAML is configured. We will attach SAML metadata in a separate email (sending now).

- IP allowlist: Not required for pilot, but we will share CIDR ranges if we move to prod.

Attaching: helix_saml_metadata.xml (SAML metadata stub).

Looking forward to the kickoff. Please include a short list of required smoke tests so we can validate quickly after keys are seeded.

Best,
Tom
Director of Platform | Helix Therapeutics
Attachment: helix_saml_metadata.xml (XML stub)

- Ben Carter: Provision service-space "helix-pilot-prod", seed keys A/B and upload key metadata to secure vault. ETA: Fri 2026-09-03 EOD PT.
